non_claims: No consumer family is SAFE_COMPATIBLE; consumers remain 0/33. L7-functional is compatibility evidence only.
The two IMPLEMENTATION findings (xilinx-bootgen BIGNUM layout, bind9 ENGINE_ALL_BUILTIN refusal) are compatibility defects, not memory-safety conclusions; neither is SAFETY_DISCHARGED.
The three L7->L4 drops (charybdis, memcached, nsd) are symmetric authority drops caused by missing transitive shared libraries in the launch environment; they are not candidate regressions.
The xilinx-bootgen candidate grade rose L4 -> L5; its below-baseline status is newly exposed by the authority reaching L7, not a drop from its prior grade.
The build-link asymmetry (authority built 253, candidate built 252) is the single pre-existing bind9 divergence; linked counts are equal (245) and candidate_specific_patch_count is 0.
The legacy provider still requires OPENSSL_MODULES because the compiled-in MODULESDIR is the empty sentinel; the no-environment drop-in goal is not met.
This receipt records observed output from one court run at one source identity; it does not establish reproducibility on another host or toolchain.
